guest_checks: Core 0 runs the scheduler; secondaries that enter startup park; LOW arms CNTP at CNTFRQ/100. IAR.ID==30 and CNTP_CTL[2:0]==5. Disable level source, ISB/DSB, write full IAR token to EOIR. Check running LOW, saved frame on its stack, nonzero work, EL1h with IRQ enabled, bounded saved PC. HIGH completes with SVC #1 after destroying live witnesses. LOW checks Z/C, X15/X19, stack words, TPIDR_EL1, V31 both lanes, FPCR/FPSR. These MMIO/register values are inferred from executed checks and PASS, not independently sampled by exception trace.
startup_assumptions: Identity-addressed MMU and D-cache off. Observed EL2 path sets HCR_EL2.RW, CNTHCTL_EL2 bits 1:0, CPTR_EL2, SCTLR_EL1, masked EL1h return. Direct EL1 entry requires prior physical counter/timer permission; not exercised.
gic: GICD 0xff841000, GICC 0xff842000. Model branch TYPER.SecurityExtn clear writes IGROUPR0 bit30, enables Group 1 at bit1 and GICC AckCtl bit2. Physical NS interface relies on secure firmware delegating PPI30 to Group 1, bit0 aliases EnableGrp1 in both CTLRs, no NS IGROUPR write. Combined EOI required, enable readback enforced. External trace records exception addresses, not raw TYPER, IAR, CNTP or EOIR.
limits: One QEMU raspi4b TCG guest, no EEPROM/VideoCore startup or SD/physical UART/power-cycle evidence. No board interrupt trace or timing certification. Two physical cold starts and board-specific trace/timing measurements outstanding.
